c74object.name: evi_DAHDSHR
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. ADSR envelope generator, similar features to MSP adsr~ but with logarithmic segments
c74object.description:
evi_DAHDSHR is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_DAHDSHR.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_approx.genexpr
ADSR by default, but actually DAHDSHR capabale generator via attributes. Logarithmic segment shapes but still capable of controlling poly~ and thispoly~, and other sample accurate processes in gen~. See evi.adsr~ for an MSP version.

constructor.digest: { arguments={}, inlets={ gate, delay, attack, hold1, decay, sustain, hold2, release } }

geninlet.name: gate
geninlet.digest: or Value. Non-zero triggers the envelope, which will sustain until a zero is received or another non-zero is received.

geninlet.name: delay
geninlet.digest: in ms @default 0. Initial delay time before the attack segment of the envelope, default in ms, but units dependent upon the @timebase attribute.

geninlet.name: attack
geninlet.digest: in ms @default 10. Attack time, default in ms, but units dependent upon the @timebase attribute.

geninlet.name: hold1
geninlet.digest: in ms @default 0. Time for first hold segment, between attack and decay, default in ms, but units dependent upon the @timebase attribute.

geninlet.name: decay
geninlet.digest: in ms @default 100. Decay time, default in ms, but units dependent upon the @timebase attribute.

geninlet.name: sustain
geninlet.digest: 0..1 @default 0.707946. Sustain level, default in linear amplitude, but units dependent upon the @sustainbase attribute.

geninlet.name: hold2
geninlet.digest: in ms @default 0. Time for second hold segment, between sustain and release, default in ms, but units dependent upon the @timebase attribute.

geninlet.name: release
geninlet.digest: in ms @default 200. Release time, default in ms, but units dependent upon the @timebase attribute.

attribute.name: envmax
attribute.description: Expected maximum of input to left trigger inlet. This can be any value, by default it assumes velocity. Only used if the @velocitysense attribute is > 0

attribute.name: fallratio
attribute.description: Ratio 0..10, minimum -120dB. Ratio 0..10, very exponential..almost linear.

attribute.name: legato
attribute.description: Flag 0/1, start from current value if reattacking active envelope (rather than ramping to zero).

attribute.name: retrigger
attribute.description: Time in ms, fade to 0 in x ms if reattacking active envelope.

attribute.name: riseratio
attribute.description: Ratio 0..10, minimum -120dB, ratio 0..10, very logarithmic..almost linear.

attribute.name: sustainbase
attribute.description: Flag 0/1, select the units used to control the 'sustain' inlet. 0=linear gain (default), 1=dB.

attribute.name: timebase
attribute.description: Flag 0/1, select the units used to control all time base inputs. 0=samples, 1=ms (default).

attribute.name: velocitycurve
attribute.description: Type -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, velocity in curve, positive=log, 0=lin, negative=exp.

attribute.name: velocitysense
attribute.description: Normalised 0..1, velocity sensitivity 0..1 (<m>envmax</m> is only used if this > 0.).

attribute.name: wait
attribute.description: Flag 0/1, wait until envelope 0 before allowing reattack of active envelope.
